## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
ROTATION. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -8.69% | 1M: -31.64%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling and Stocks vs Bonds (SPY/TLT via SPY (1W: +0.90% | 1M: +5.26%) ABOVE TREND) ↑ rising confirm mixed risk preferences against rising credit stress (HYG/LQD flagged ↑).

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**  
Credit stress EASING/RE-PRICING signal mixed: HYG (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +1.36%) ABOVE TREND but HYG/LQD flagged CREDIT STRESS ↑. Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -8.69% | 1M: -31.64%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling; Stocks vs Bonds (1W: +1.38% | 1M: +5.98%) ABOVE TREND supports risk-on tilt within a rotation.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
Dollar down: UUP (1W: -3.22% | 1M: -4.86%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling; yield signals mixed with TLT (1W: +0.34% | 1M: -1.36%) RECOVERY and Yield Curve (1W: -0.22%) → flat BELOW TREND, leaving conditions broadly neutral-to-easing.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Materials leading: XLB (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +12.26%) ABOVE TREND; Financials strong: XLF (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +12.12%) ABOVE TREND; Tech also positive: XLK (1W: +2.01% | 1M: +6.68%) ABOVE TREND — style: Growth/momentum showing leadership amid rotation.

**5. US vs Global?**  
US outperforms: SPY (1W: +0.90% | 1M: +5.26%) ABOVE TREND while EM/Emerging catch-up: EEM (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +3.15%) ABOVE TREND and China FXI (1W: +0.80% | 1M: +1.22%) ABOVE TREND, though Japan lagging and some European names in CORRECTION (EWJ (1W: -1.65% | 1M: +5.01%) CORRECTION).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Risk-on flows into smaller and thematic risk: IWM (1W: +0.99% | 1M: +11.05%) ABOVE TREND, ARKK (1W: +2.88% | 1M: +13.57%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +2.94% | 1M: +2.31%) ABOVE TREND indicate healthy speculative appetite.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Precious metals leadership evident: PPLT (1W: +17.69% | 1M: +39.64%) ABOVE TREND, SLV (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +36.46%) ABOVE TREND and GLD (1W: +3.14% | 1M: +8.90%) ABOVE TREND; base/industrial metals also strong: CPER (1W: +1.75% | 1M: +9.62%) ABOVE TREND.

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Energy mixed-to-weak: XLE (1W: -2.17% | 1M: -0.50%) BELOW TREND while BNO (1W: +2.51% | 1M: -0.83%) RECOVERY; NatGas weak: UNG (1W: -4.90% | 1M: -17.82%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
CONFIRMED: XLK (1W: +2.01% | 1M: +6.68%) ABOVE TREND and XLF (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +12.12%) ABOVE TREND show concurrent strength; DIVERGENCE: XRT (1W: -0.64% | 1M: +12.77%) CORRECTION and several defensives (XLU (1W: -1.74% | 1M: -3.50%) BELOW TREND) show 1W vs 1M mismatches to monitor.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor cyclicals and select growth: XLB, XLF and XLK showing strength while reducing exposure to Utilities/REITs (XLU (1W: -1.74% | 1M: -3.50%) BELOW TREND; Real Estate (1W: -2.07% | 1M: +0.50%) BELOW TREND). Monitor HYG/LQD credit stress signal and VXX complacency levels as key risk controls.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: Materials XLB (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +12.26%) ABOVE TREND; Financials XLF (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +12.12%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Utilities XLU (1W: -1.74% | 1M: -3.50%) BELOW TREND; Energy XLE (1W: -2.17% | 1M: -0.50%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: Silver SLV (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +36.46%) ABOVE TREND and Platinum PPLT (1W: +17.69% | 1M: +39.64%) ABOVE TREND; BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -4.90% | 1M: -17.82%) BELOW TREND and agriculture names (WEAT (1W: -0.25% | 1M: -3.58%) BELOW TREND).

**13. Key Levels?**  
VXX at ~26.99 (VXX (1W: -8.69% | 1M: -31.64%) BELOW TREND) marks current complacency/fear barometer; Credit Spread ~0.7305 (1W: +0.19%) flags stress level; Stocks vs Bonds ~7.8392 (1W: +1.38%) ABOVE TREND as a risk-on tilt; watch XLK/XLF ratio ~2.62 for leadership shifts.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive.  
Materials (XLB (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +12.26%) ABOVE TREND), Financials (XLF (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +12.12%) ABOVE TREND) and Tech (XLK (1W: +2.01% | 1M: +6.68%) ABOVE TREND) showing relative strength.  
Key risk: rising credit-stress signal (HYG/LQD flagged ↑) and short-term divergences in retail/defensive ETFs (XRT, XLU) to monitor.
